name: Rock 'em and Sock 'em
summary: Sleebo asks you to test G45-B4G, his gas-powered engine prototype. The trial will give him notes for repairs and changes.

sections.title: A Mechanical Trial
sections.body: Sleebo has one working prototype of his gas-powered engine, housed in G45-B4G's burlap chest. He can power the mechanical companion with gas you have collected. You are asked to test the machine in a fight so Sleebo can see how it performs.

sections.title: Sleebo's Notes
sections.body: After the test, Sleebo is pleased with the spectacle and the notes he gathered. He plans to repair G45-B4G and adjust the engine before the next test.

faq.answer: G45-B4G is Sleebo's mechanical companion and houses the working prototype of his gas-powered engine in a burlap chest.

faq.q: Why is Sleebo testing his invention?
faq.answer: Sleebo wants to stress test the gas-powered engine prototype and gather notes on how it performs.
